newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Hotel Leela down 5.2 pct on NSE.
newsitem.headline: India's Hotel Leela down 5.2 pct on NSE.

text.p: Shares of India's Hotel Leelaventure shed 5.30 rupees or 5.2 pct to 95.80 on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) in early trade, brokers said.
They said a couple of foreign funds were sellers in the stock due to an expected slowdown in earnings growth.
Analysts say the company will need to tap external sources of finance for its aggressive growth plans over the next four years.
This is likely to depress earnings growth on a three-year outlook with the stock underperforming the market, they say.
